_comment: Shared pinning table for the tmux-name -> display-name derivation.
two implementations of 'strip the cloude_ prefix, then replace
underscores with spaces' cannot silently drift apart again - see
hazard: one conversation rendered as 'Media_Compression' on one
Scoped to NON-DEGENERATE names only (something survives the prefix
strip and the underscore replacement). The one deliberate,
documented non-mirror - a name that is ONLY the prefix - is tested
separately in each language's own suite, because the two functions
disagree there on purpose: label_from_tmux_name falls back to the
raw tmux name (a stored title column may never be blank);
stripAppPrefix returns null (outcome 3 of the three-outcome
display rule - 'this session cannot be named').
